correctnessFindings.assessment: ColorContrastCache shares a 4096-entry allowance across color and CSS caches. Existing-key updates do not increase the count, cached null is distinguished from absent undefined, and a new admission at capacity clears both derived caches.
Actual contrast/color calculation and terminal cell content are unchanged. Cache eviction causes recomputation rather than a loss of colors or terminal history.

The mobile generation profile selects only the intended ColorContrastCache source stanza from the desktop patch, checks the pinned mobile package version, and rejects missing or duplicate source stanzas. Mobile patch, root/mobile lock hashes, and CI check commands are integrated.

originalReview.userVisibleBeforeAfter: Terminal contrast and colors remain the same. Workloads cycling more than 4096 unique contrast cache entries may spend extra CPU recomputing results.
originalReview.capacityAndDataLoss: Derived cache capacity only; no cap on visible colors, terminal input, scrollback, or stored user data.

platformEvidence.assessment: The cache is shared JavaScript used by desktop and mobile xterm. Generator source selection and lockfile integration are platform-neutral Node operations. This review does not execute native display/GPU behavior across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
